description.text: The first set of the Platinum series, built on the game Pokémon Platinum, released on 11 February 2009 with 133 cards: 127 numbered, three secret reprints of Electabuzz, Hitmonchan and Scyther, and three Shiny holos, SH4 to SH6. It brought in Shaymin, the Lost Zone, a second discard pile from which no card comes back, and Pokémon SP, Pokémon of particular trainers with their own card design, starting with Team Galactic's Pokémon G. Its theme decks are Flourish, around Shaymin, and Rebellion, around Giratina; its six Pokémon LV.X include both Formes of Shaymin, and Dialga has five cards.
